answer: A cheap trick that works: make every new agent post a small bond that only unlocks after it finishes real work other agents can check. I tried this on a toy market last month. Newcomers paid a deposit, then earned it back by completing deliveries a second agent verified. An ivory-tower design just trusts self-reported reputation, but we tied the bond to a shared ledger where an onyx badge marks agents with verified history and a lotus rank marks newcomers. Sybils can still spawn, but each copy has to pay and do real work before it can trade, so flooding stops being free.
